title: First Annual Student Triva Night!
description: Time 6:30 P.M. A delicious meal will be provided The trivia is based on the survey questionnaire that the students filled out a few weeks ago.  Highly unlikely we will have geography questions. Prizes will be awarded and a champion will be crowned. Hope to see you and your friends there.

title: Lockout 2.0
description: The Lockout 2.0 is scheduled for Friday May 15th! The total cost is $60, and we are collecting a deposit of $20 to hold your student's spot because space is limited. Students can bring as many friends as they would like. This event is for students in grades 6-12. Please turn in the forms and deposit to the church office by Sunday, May 10th.
